annotation.title_clean: Launching the Artificial Intelligence Playbook for the UK Government
annotation.title_en: Launching the Artificial Intelligence Playbook for the UK Government
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Government Digital Service (GDS), Department for Science, Innovation and Technology
annotation.summary_en: GDS blog post announcing the UK Government's AI Playbook, launched 10 February 2025, which gives civil servants and public bodies guidance on safe and effective AI use. It has five parts: 10 principles, introducing AI, building AI, using AI safely, and use-case appendices. Training courses accompany it. It does not cover embodied AI.
key_provisions_or_claims: AI Playbook launched by Technology Secretary Peter Kyle for departments and public sector organisations
Five parts: 10 principles, introducing AI, building AI, using AI safely and responsibly, and use-case appendix
Covers bias, privacy, copyright, data protection and cybersecurity
Each section has a checklist of practical actions
Complemented by AI courses on Civil Service Learning and regular playbook updates
